Definition: large (in size, quantity or number, also adverbial)
BiblicalUsage: In Aramaic, saggîyʼ means large (in size, quantity or number, also adverbial). It stands in Daniel 2:6, "…gifts and rewards and great honour: therefore shew…", and in Ezra 5:11, "…builded these many years ago, which a great…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that saggîyʼ counts, because God put it in his book.
